data.one_liner: Fuzzy search in Dart, ported from Fuse.js.
data.what_it_does: Performs fuzzy searching on lists of strings or objects in Dart. It supports weighted searches via predefined getters and string normalization.
use_when: You need to implement fuzzy searching over lists of data in Dart or Flutter
You want a Dart port inspired by Fuse.js
avoid_when: You need full-text database search indexing for massive server-side datasets
strengths: Supports generic types and weighted searches
Includes string normalization and tokenization options
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of README and basic options
